answer: A farm paying its aliases from one wallet therefore collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. Because the prism graph is rebuilt each epoch, the vault merge is applied at settlement and the atlas audit lists every linked key. Identities funded from a common source within 24 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. That is 40 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
